newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran floods kill seven villagers, derail train.
newsitem.headline: Iran floods kill seven villagers, derail train.

text.p: Floods following heavy rains killed seven people in northwestern Iran and caused $5 million in damage, state-run Tehran radio said on Saturday.
It said the floods killed seven villagers and derailed three carriages of a train on a railway connecting the provincial capital of Tabriz to Tehran, injuring 18 passengers.
Tehran radio said the flooding destroyed 350 houses in rural areas and damaged some buildings in Tabriz.
Total damage to buildings, fields and roads was estimated at 15 billion rials ($5 million).
Iranian television quoted a state railways official as saying repairs to the line, which also connects Iran to Turkey and Azerbijan, were expected to be completed late on Saturday.
